raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents a pie chart illustrating responses to the statement "Дизайнът е добре интегриран в процеса на разработване на продукти в нашата организация?". The chart is divided into six sectors, each representing a different level of agreement or disagreement. The sectors are colored blue, green, red, purple, pink, and orange. The blue sector, labeled "Изцяло интегриран," occupies approximately 10% of the pie. The green sector, labeled "Добре е интегриран," represents roughly 25%. The red sector, labeled "Много добре е интегриран," accounts for about 24%. The purple sector, labeled "Не е интегриран такъв подход," represents approximately 20%. The pink sector, labeled "Слабо е интегриран," occupies about 8%. The chart includes a legend displaying the labels and corresponding numerical values (10, 24, 25, 8, and 20) for each sector. The sectors appear to be arranged in descending order of size, from green to red to purple to blue to pink to orange.
